name: 林子喬
objective: This course introduces the fundamental concepts, mathematical modeling, and dynamic behavior of electric power systems under small disturbances. Emphasis is placed on synchronous machine modeling, excitation systems, small-signal stability analysis, and multimachine system dynamics. Students will learn analytical techniques and simulation methods used in modern power system stability studies and understand the impact of control systems on system stability.
課程進度(1-16週):
Wk1: Course introduction and rules.
Wk2~Wk3: Introduction to stability and mathematical models.
Wk4~Wk5: Synchronous machine fundamentals and electromechanical dynamics.
Wk6: Park's transformation and dq-axis machine equations.
Wk7~Wk8: Network modeling, per-unit system, state-space representation. 
"Wk9: Midterm closed-book exam."
Wk10~Wk12: Small disturbance analysis.
Wk13~Wk14: Simulation of synchronous machines.
Wk15: Multimachine systems.
"Wk16: Final closed-book exam"
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          第 17 至 18 週由學生依個人學習需求，自主複習電力系統穩定度相關內容，並透過教材研讀與題目練習強化電力系統穩定度分析能力。
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          能理解電力系統穩定度數理分析之基本概念與方法，並運用所學完成相關問題之分析與計算。
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          10%
